title: Founding membership is now open
excerpt: Oberlin students can join the mailing list, propose a project, or express interest in an open role.
body: The society is recruiting its first members and officers. Current priorities are confirming the first meeting, choosing one or two semester projects, and gathering the 3-2 questions students want to discuss. Students from any major or class year are welcome.
author: Frank (Kwaku) Kusi Appiah
